Name: Cattails
Author: Kanadeyoru
Description:
This is a simple mod that adds the animated cattails found on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10448]Lumisteria Tilesheets - Outdoor[/url] to Stardew Valley's rivers and lakes!
This is compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded.

Mods seen on the screenshots:
